whatMakesDifferent.question: What sets Veo4 apart from other video generation platforms?
whatMakesDifferent.answer: Veo4 excels at building extended narratives through Veo4 Storyboard, maintaining character consistency throughout. While competitors limit output to brief clips, Veo4 produces 25+ second stories ideal for brand campaigns, product launches, and social content. Veo4 Storyboard gives you scene-by-scene control, preserves character identity, and delivers campaign-ready Veo4 videos.

characterConsistency.question: How does Veo4 maintain character consistency across scenes?
characterConsistency.answer: Veo4 Storyboard preserves character appearance, wardrobe, and styling across every scene in your Veo4 video. This Veo4 capability is crucial for brand narratives, character-driven campaigns, and product demonstrations where consistent identity matters.

videosLongerThan10s.question: Can Veo4 generate videos longer than 10 seconds?
videosLongerThan10s.answer: Yes. Veo4 supports extended durations up to 25-30 seconds via Veo4 Storyboard mode. This Veo4 feature solves a key limitation, enabling full brand stories rather than fragmented clips. Veo4 extended videos perform better in campaigns.

commercialUse.question: Are Veo4 videos suitable for commercial advertising?
commercialUse.answer: Absolutely. Veo4 generated content is fully licensed for commercial use, including paid ads, e-commerce videos, and social campaigns. You retain full rights to Veo4 videos you create, subject to our usage guidelines.

watermarks.question: Do Veo4 videos include watermarks?
watermarks.answer: No — all Veo4 exports are completely watermark-free. Premium Veo4 plans ensure no platform branding appears on downloads. Your Veo4 videos export clean and ready for immediate campaign deployment. Note: This applies only to watermarks added by our platform, not third-party content.

25SecondVideos.question: Can I build 25-second Veo4 videos?
25SecondVideos.answer: Yes — Veo4 Storyboard enables 25-second Veo4 multi-scene generation for complete brand narratives.

paymentSafe.question: If I make a payment, will my payment information be safe?
paymentSafe.answer: Absolutely. We use secure, trusted payment platforms and banks. Your payment is fully protected, and no personal information will ever be exposed or leaked.

hiddenCharges.question: Are there any hidden charges?
hiddenCharges.answer: No, the price displayed is the total amount you'll pay. There are no additional hidden fees. Annual plans save up to 50% compared to monthly billing.

faqCancelAnytime.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faqCancelAnytime.answer: Yes! All plans can be canceled anytime. You'll retain access until the end of your billing period.

faqCreditsRollOver.question: Do unused credits roll over?
faqCreditsRollOver.answer: Subscription bucket resets each billing period and does not roll over. One-time add-on credits go to the flexible bucket and are not cleared by subscription resets.

faqRefundPolicy.question: What is veo4video.io refund policy?
faqRefundPolicy.answer: We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee for all subscription plans. Contact support@veo4video.io for refunds. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

faqContentRestrictions.question: Are there any video content restrictions?
faqContentRestrictions.answer: Our platform enforces strict content policies. We prohibit the generation of harmful, illegal, or inappropriate content. All generated videos undergo automatic screening to ensure policy compliance.

faqCreditsDeduction.question: Will credits be deducted if generation fails?
faqCreditsDeduction.answer: No. Credits are deducted atomically when a job starts, and automatically refunded if the generation fails or the upstream service returns an error. Refunds usually appear within a minute.

faqCancelSubscription.question: What happens to credits if I cancel my subscription?
faqCancelSubscription.answer: You can cancel anytime. Flexible (one-time) credits remain available. Subscription bucket follows your billing period and stops refreshing after the current period ends.

whatIsTool.question: What is the Image to Video tool?
whatIsTool.answer: Our AI Image to Video tool transforms your static images into fully animated videos using advanced AI. Simply upload your photo, illustration, or product image, and the AI brings it to life with natural motion, camera movements, and synchronized audio.

needExperience.question: Do I need any animation or video editing experience to use the Image to Video tool?
needExperience.answer: No experience is needed. Simply upload your image file, and the AI will automatically generate a high-quality animated video with natural motion and professional effects - no technical skills required.

imageTypes.question: What types of images work best with the Image to Video tool?
imageTypes.answer: The tool works with a wide variety of images including product photos, portraits, landscapes, illustrations, architectural photos, and design mockups. The AI analyzes the composition and generates motion that makes sense contextually for each image type.

howLong.question: How long does it take to generate a video from an image?
howLong.answer: Most videos are generated in just a few minutes, depending on complexity. The AI analyzes your image, generates motion, and adds synchronized audio. You'll be able to preview and download your animated video once it's ready.

motionType.question: What kind of motion does the AI add to images?
motionType.answer: The AI generates contextually appropriate motion such as smooth camera movements, natural object motion, environmental effects (like wind through trees), product rotations, and subtle portrait movements. The motion enhances the image without being distracting.

commercialUse.question: Can I use Image to Video generated videos for commercial purposes?
